subject: Hospitality
title: Wellness Events and Retreats
description: A quick win: understand Wellness Events and Retreats.

hook.text: Wellness retreats—yoga, meditation, fitness festivals—are a $4+ billion segment growing 12% annually.

buildup.text: Events like Wanderlust and Summit blend wellness programming with music, food, and community.

discovery.text: Hotels host corporate wellness retreats replacing traditional off-sites. Teams attend mindfulness workshops, not slide decks.

twist.text: Wellness events attract high spenders. Per-person spending at wellness retreats is 130% higher than at traditional leisure events.

climax.text: The intersection of wellness, hospitality, and events creates experiences that transform—not just entertain.

punchline.text: $4 billion, growing 12% annually. Wellness events heal guests—and hotel revenue.

quiz.question: How does per-person spending at wellness retreats compare to traditional events?
options: 130% higher than at traditional leisure events
